task.title: Relics: import and export files larger than 64 MiB
task.description:
A relic is a record in Workbook beside tasks. It holds specs, plans, decisions and similar material as named parts, with the same history and sharing that tasks have.

This is a follow-up from the review of the first six relics stories (finding D18). It was left out of that work on purpose.

## Problem

`workbook relic create --from-file` refuses an input over 64 MiB before it parses it, because the whole file is held in memory. A relic can grow past what one import accepts, and the import limit is separate from the size limits of a relic itself.

## Wanted

Explore reading the file as a stream, so its size is not bound by a memory buffer, and what should happen when the file describes a relic that is over the relic size limits.

## Done when

- A written recommendation: stream or keep the cap, with measurements of memory use.
- A decision on importing a relic that is over the size limits.

## Notes

Dylan asked for this on 2026-11-26 when he approved the 64 MiB cap.
